full_page.content:
1941, July 24
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. Bonaventure's Monastery 1740 Mt. Elliott Ave. Detroit, Michigan July 24, 1941
Rev. M. Joachim Casey Mount Hope Baltimore, M'd.
My Dear Brother -- Father M. Joachim:
God bless you and yours. I've been trying to get in touch you for weeks. - -- Am sending you herewith Jim's letter received last Monday.
There is since I started this card just a dozen people came in waiting. I wanted to tell you about the jubilee we had out in Royal Oak. There was surely a grand crowd . . about fifty priests -- bishops and sisters. (3 Capuchins)
God bless you again and Oremus pro invicem In Cord Jesu . .
Fr. Solanus
